cues.inhalt: Closest sphere packing seen from above: touching circles in a triangular lattice, a gold hexagon drawn around the central sphere.

cues.inhalt: Master circle with inner core: standing-wave pattern across all three shells in lens shapes—gold in the inner core, white in the liquid shell, grey in the mantle.
